posts.text:
Lindsey Graham was one of the leading voices on the SAVE America Act up until his final hours. 

He talked to President Trump hours before he passed, telling him the Senate was ready to move.

He didn't chase easy fights. He pushed for REAL election integrity because he believed it was common sense. He never backed off no matter how long it stalled in the Senate.

He was a warrior. 

We must get his wish across the finish line. PASS THE SAVE AMERICA ACT.
posts.summary: Praises Graham's work on election integrity legislation
